name: @arena/expert-performance
description: Arena expert performance (Work Order C005; issue #112) — the long-term memory of expert quality. PerformanceProfile: the append-only, provenance-addressable, DIMENSION-SEPARATED longitudinal evidence profile per expert (spec/quality-model.md Expert quality: competency by skill, task-family performance, agreement, review outcomes, consistency, domain/jurisdiction fit, recentness/freshness, conflicts/limitations). The no-single-global-score law is enforced STRUCTURALLY: read surfaces return dimensional evidence only; any aggregate is a typed, versioned, SINGLE-DIMENSION summary that discloses its formula, sample sizes and known limitations — a cross-dimension aggregate or a global/overall score has no construction path (every attempt fails closed with EXPERT_PERFORMANCE_GLOBAL_SCORE_REJECTED). Attribution discipline (LE1.0 vocabulary via A020): every evidence record attributes expert-change vs evaluator-change vs measurement-variance, and a record whose evaluator version digest changed can NEVER be recorded as an expert performance change (EXPERT_PERFORMANCE_ATTRIBUTION_VIOLATION). Freshness/decay: an explicit versioned per-dimension staleness-window policy — evidence is never silently decayed; stale evidence surfaces as stale with reasons. Ingestion maps the merged dep surfaces (C004 calibration verdicts, A007 qualification + match history, A019 skill-extraction outcomes, A020 attribution records) into evidence records through pure, closed mapping tables — never direct writes into dep state. Performance evidence is DATA, never authorization and never correctness verification (lock rules 9/35). Tenant isolation at the domain level.
